title: Spill The Slang
style: Pop-rap with bouncy trap drums and a swung groove; verse rides tight drum-bass pockets with playful conversational rhymes, pre-chorus strips to filtered claps and hand percussion, chorus pops with stacked doubles and gang vocals on the hook. Add tape-stop fills, vocal chop stabs, and a bright synth bounce between lines. Crisp, punchy, radio-ready mix with a glossy low end.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You say “what’s good?”
I say “what’s poppin’”
You say “I’m out”
I say “I’m hoppin’”
You call it money
I call it paper
You move too slow
I’m on that flavor

New kicks clean
Fresh out the box
Pull up quick
Then I’m cutting the locks
You say “for real?”
I say “no cap”
Big talk back?
Man, I been that

[Pre-Chorus]
Okay, okay
Now you catch the wave
Talk that way
It hits different, babe
Old slang, new slang
Let it swing all day
When you say it right
You don’t need to explain

[Chorus]
Spill the slang, spill the slang
Talk that talk, let it bang
Spill the slang, spill the slang
Say it loud, let it hang
What’s good, what’s up
That’s the move, that’s enough
Spill the slang, spill the slang
Say it like you mean it, huh

[Verse 2]
You got that drip
When you step in sharp
I’m low-key lit
But I play it dark
If it’s all cap
Then I’m out the door
If it’s real talk
Then I want some more

You say “bet”
I say “say less”
You got the tea
I want the mess
From coast to coast
It rolls like dice
One quick phrase
Can change the vibe

[Pre-Chorus]
Okay, okay
Now you catch the wave
Talk that way
It hits different, babe
Old slang, new slang
Let it swing all day
When you say it right
You don’t need to explain

[Chorus]
Spill the slang, spill the slang
Talk that talk, let it bang
Spill the slang, spill the slang
Say it loud, let it hang
What’s good, what’s up
That’s the move, that’s enough
Spill the slang, spill the slang
Say it like you mean it, huh

[Bridge]
From the diner booth to the corner store
Every little phrase wants a little more
Say “my bad”
Say “no sweat”
One small word
And the whole room gets it

[Final Chorus]
Spill the slang, spill the slang
Talk that talk, let it bang
Spill the slang, spill the slang
Say it loud, let it hang
What’s good, what’s up
That’s the move, that’s enough
Spill the slang, spill the slang
Say it like you mean it, huh
